title: Event Sourcing • Greg Young • GOTO 2014
summary: Greg Young, who coined CQRS, gives an in-depth GOTO 2014 talk on what event sourcing is, when it is valuable and when it is not, along with its trade-offs and common misconceptions.
why: HN commenters list it among the best introductions to event sourcing and use it to illustrate storing read-only events instead of mutating state.

quote.text: Here's a youtube video about the benefits and attributes of event-sourcing.
